preconditions.description: The length of the input text is no more than 10000 characters.

preconditions.expression: input_text.isalpha() or input_text.isspace() or input_text in '.,!?'
preconditions.description: The input text consists of lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and punctuation marks.
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: all(input_text[i].isalpha() and input_text[i+1].isalpha() for i in range(len(input_text)-1) if input_text[i] == ' ' and input_text[i+1] == ' ')
preconditions.description: There are no consecutive spaces in the input text.

preconditions.expression: all(input_text[i].isalpha() and input_text[i+1] in '.,!?' for i in range(len(input_text)-1) if input_text[i] != ' ' and input_text[i+1] != ' ')
preconditions.description: There is at least one word between any two punctuation marks.

postconditions.description: The output text has no extra spaces at the end and no consecutive spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(output_text[i] == ' ' and output_text[i+1] not in '.,!?' for i in range(len(output_text)-1) if output_text[i].isalpha() and output_text[i+1].isalpha())
postconditions.description: Words are separated by exactly one space if there is no punctuation mark between them.

postconditions.expression: all(output_text[i] in '.,!?' and output_text[i+1] == ' ' for i in range(len(output_text)-1) if output_text[i].isalpha())
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space after each punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all(output_text[i] not in '.,!?' or output_text[i-1] == ' ' for i in range(len(output_text)))
postconditions.description: There are no spaces before each punctuation mark.
